contexts.text: That the truth of the Church is obscured to (the Jews) is represented at this day by their covering themselves with veils in their synagogues.

But are the synagogue of Satan () = because they are in falsities as to doctrine. The synagogue is mentioned because the Jews are; and, as they taught in the synagogues, by a synagogue is signified doctrine. AR 181. AE 120, Explained, Illustrated.
That differences in matters of doctrine were adjusted in the synagogues. Illustrated.
I will give from the synagogue of Satan () = those in the doctrine of faith alone and in no charity. Explained.
